install:
export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"
export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"
command -v bun >/dev/null || curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"
MARKER="# munkel-cloud-electron-gpu"
if ! grep -qF "$MARKER" "$HOME/.profile" 2>/dev/null; then printf '%s\n' "$MARKER" 'export MUNKEL_ELECTRON_DISABLE_GPU=1' 'export ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1' 'export LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1' >> "$HOME/.profile"; fi
if ! grep -qF "$MARKER" "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null; then printf '%s\n' "$MARKER" 'export MUNKEL_ELECTRON_DISABLE_GPU=1' 'export ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1' 'export LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; fi
bun install
start:
export DISPLAY="${DISPLAY:-:1}"
MARKER="# munkel-cloud-electron-gpu"
if ! grep -qF "$MARKER" "$HOME/.profile" 2>/dev/null; then printf '%s\n' "$MARKER" 'export MUNKEL_ELECTRON_DISABLE_GPU=1' 'export ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1' 'export LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1' >> "$HOME/.profile"; fi
if ! grep -qF "$MARKER" "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null; then printf '%s\n' "$MARKER" 'export MUNKEL_ELECTRON_DISABLE_GPU=1' 'export ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1' 'export LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; fi
if command -v xfce4-panel >/dev/null; then xfconf-query -c xfce4-panel -lv 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'systray' || xfce4-panel --add=systray || true; fi
